name: Sketch to Image
tagline: Draw a freehand massing sketch and get a styled, photoreal architectural render in seconds.
description: Renders a freehand line sketch into a photoreal architectural exterior live as it's drawn, with a choice of base model and swappable LoRA styles (an organic 'Bio Architecture' look, a smooth parametric curved-form look), output resolution up to 768px, and a downloadable image.

page.objective: Let a designer see a photoreal read on a massing idea while still sketching it, not after modelling it.
page.problem: Getting from a rough massing idea to a presentable render normally means building and rendering a 3D model first.
page.solution: A freehand sketch renders live into a styled photoreal exterior, with swappable base models, LoRA styles, and resolution.

highlights.headline: A rough scribble becomes a styled photoreal render in about two seconds.
points: Sketch to photoreal in seconds — a freehand line renders into a full exterior as it is drawn.
Swap style: organic form — an LoRA preset for an organic, lava-textured massing.
Parametric curved-form style — a base model + LoRA combination for smooth curved towers.
Pick model & resolution — choice of base architectural model and output resolution (512-768px).
